caption: The image depicts a round ceramic plate with a detailed, monochrome illustration in shades of gray and black. The central scene shows a river steamboat with two flags, smoke billowing from its funnel, traveling along a choppy body of water. In the foreground, there are five human figures standing on the shore, some pointing towards the steamboat, while trees and foliage frame the scene. The wide rim of the plate is decorated with an array of large, detailed marine shells and corals, interspersed with botanical elements such as leaves and flowers, creating an ornate border that encircles the central image. The entire composition is rendered with fine lines and shading, giving depth and texture to both the central river scene and the decorative rim.
title: Plate - "Steamer, Union Line"
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
